message.content: {"note_claim": "Troy Lake was sentenced to 12 months and 1 day for disabling emissions systems on hundreds of commercial trucks at his repair business, not 7 years for fixing his own vehicle.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Lake pleaded guilty and was sentenced to serve 12 months and one day of federal prison time, served at the FCI Florence minimum-security prison camp in Colorado, and to pay a $2,500 fine.", "reason": "The page states the 12 months and one day sentence and describes tampering with emissions diagnostic systems in at least 344 trucks at his business, Elite Diesel Service, rather than fixing his own vehicle."}

parsed.note_claim: Troy Lake was sentenced to 12 months and 1 day for disabling emissions systems on hundreds of commercial trucks at his repair business, not 7 years for fixing his own vehicle.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Lake pleaded guilty and was sentenced to serve 12 months and one day of federal prison time, served at the FCI Florence minimum-security prison camp in Colorado, and to pay a $2,500 fine.
parsed.reason: The page states the 12 months and one day sentence and describes tampering with emissions diagnostic systems in at least 344 trucks at his business, Elite Diesel Service, rather than fixing his own vehicle.
